channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Opinion: Even when it is OK to criticize Trump, Owens misses the mark
item.description: Leadership requires moral courage, NAACP president Jeanetta Williams says, in wake of Trump's racist post about the Obamas

item.title: Even before Russell M. Nelson, an LDS Church president broke barriers with NAACP
item.description: Jeanetta Williams, head of the NAACP's Salt Lake Branch for more than 30 years, made overtures to the LDS Church decades ago and continues to work for racial unity.

item.title: Tribune Editorial: Cox and Lee, not U.S. Olympians, embarrass America on a global scale
item.description: Tribune editorial: Our athletes are intelligent, well-traveled adults, mostly in their 20s and 30s, not kids in need of Daddy-knows-best guidance from the likes of Spencer Cox and Mike Lee.

item.title: Letter: It seems Gov. Cox has morphed into Phil Lyman
item.description: Letter: Spencer Cox’s push to pack the Utah Supreme Court in favor of far-right Republicans won’t just disenfranchise millions of Utahns — it will cost us millions of dollars, too.

item.title: Letter: Utah lawmaker’s bill to rename the West Bank is designed to foment violence
item.description: Letter: As a Jew and a rabbi, I believe the Jewish people have a historical connection to the West Bank — but so do Palestinians. Karianne Lisonbee’s bill to rename it will do nothing except inflame tensions and foment violence.

item.title: Letter: Salt Lake City rally will amplify Ukraine’s defiant fight for liberty
item.description: Letter: We invite all who value freedom to stand with us and support Ukraine’s fight for liberty in a Rally for Ukraine on the south steps of the Utah Capitol, at noon on Saturday, Feb. 28.

item.title: This week from Bagley: Gov. Cox vs. athletes’ free speech, the Epstein files, Utah Legislature, Trump’s racism
item.description: This week from Bagley: Gov. Cox vs. athletes’ free speech, the Epstein files, Utah Legislature, Trump’s racism

item.title: More than 16 million tons of radioactive mill waste removed from project near the Colorado River
item.description: Radioactive mill waste has largely been removed from the Colorado River site, with remaining cleanup continuing toward a planned 2029 closure.

item.title: BYU basketball team loses star player for the season, a massive blow to its Final Four dreams
item.description: BYU basketball star Richie Saunders is done for the season.

item.title: ‘We have met the threshold’: GOP says they have enough signatures to send Prop 4 repeal to Utah voters
item.description: “We are well over 200,000 signatures that have been submitted. We have met the threshold,” Utah GOP Chair Rob Axson said Sunday.
